description: Connects a human gene to a protein it encodes, based on NCBI Gene ID cross-references in UniProt.

source_contributions.scope: Human proteins (NCBI Taxonomy ID 9606) from manually reviewed Swiss-Prot and computationally annotated TrEMBL entries. Only entries with NCBI Gene ID cross-references and corresponding Gene and Protein nodes in SPOKE are represented. Targets are regular parent proteins, excluding chain proteins (polyprotein cleavage products).
source_contributions.description: Each NCBI Gene ID cross-reference links a gene to the entry’s primary UniProt accession. Multiple Gene ID cross-references can link a protein to multiple genes. Proteins marked obsolete are not explicitly excluded.
